title: Contest Session Log Manifest
description: manifest.json schema (v1.0). Required at the root of each demo repo's logs/ directory.

github_login.description: The GitHub username this manifest belongs to. Matches the parent logs/<github_login>/ directory name.

generator.description: (Optional) Plugin version string that generated this manifest, e.g. 'opencode-collector@1.0.0'.

collection_mode.description: Data collection mode. cli=full CLI capture; vscode_extension=full VS Code extension capture; vscode_extension_partial=partial (e.g. Claude Code main transcript missing); backfill-sqlite=recovered from OpenCode/MiMoCode SQLite; backfill-cursor=recovered from Cursor global+workspace state.vscdb

data_completeness_warning.description: (Recommended when collection_mode=vscode_extension_partial) Description of missing data.

tokens_total.description: (Optional) Cumulative token usage for this session, used for token-plan upgrade audits.

redacted_count_total.description: (Optional) Cumulative redaction substitution count for this session.

health.description: Session collection health: ok=normal; degraded=partial errors logged in errors/; error=fully failed
